analysis: The batch covers documentation-only text: CHANGELOG.md (v0.10.13 candidate section, head 11-45) and docs/architecture/inference.md (cluster-stop prose at head 453-473, loop-exit-thinking prose at head 3239-3286). The integration replay also shows doc edits in docs/provider/two-mac-cluster.md, the stopsAsked field in ClusterSetupWizardStore.swift, and the version bump in ProviderCore.swift (0.10.12 to 0.10.13). The only Swift change visible is one optional Int field (stopsAsked) and a version string; neither alters key custody, attestation, encryption, authorization or the coordinator wire contract. The implementations behind #2040 (Gemma 4 loop-exit-thinking continuation) and #2042 (cluster stop counter via ClusterControlReply.stopsAsked, OnboardingLive.stop/localServe) are not in the supplied source (281 units omitted, replay incomplete). Security-relevant claims need code review. (1) Loop-exit continuation: it resubmits prompt + thought + <channel|> as a new row with the same cache scope and sampling, max 8,192 tokens. Check that cacheScope/cacheSalt is preserved (T-041), the encrypted response path is unchanged (T-008), cancel/deadline/budget are honored (T-010), logprobs and pair exclusions hold, the 5 s slot-release wait cannot be abused (T-029), and logs stay content-free. (2) Stop counter: the count is peer-reported over the paired cluster control link. Confirm that channel is authenticated and bound to the member identity, that a nil count from older builds only fails toward following the start, and that the compare under the command lock holds. Impact is limited to onboarding availability (A-018), not data exposure. (3) The changelog claims that registration fields, MLX pins and mlx.metallib are unchanged; this is unverified and relates to A-017/T-054. The T-041 at-rest posture (HMAC names, 30-min TTL, KEK) is not altered by anything visible. No concrete regression is established; the code behind these claims is a coverage limit, so deeper review is requested.
